scope: Discovery of successful medium-cost exported-CNF checker cases; original certificates only are independently kernel-checked.

bands.near_limit: >90 seconds, still below the 120-second pipeline cap

commands.replay: python3 scripts/replay_checker_medium.py --selection SELECTION --saved SAVED --micromath CHECKER --micromath-git REV --build-report BUILD --cadical CADICAL --workflow-git COMMIT --shard INDEX --shards 4 --coefficient-statistics

command:
set -uo pipefail
save=()
if [[ -n $7 ]]; then save=(--save "$7"); fi
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$1" "$2" "$3" - --raw --cadical "$4" "${save[@]}" \
  2> "$6/producer.err" |
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$5" "$2" - > "$6/kernel.out" 2> "$6/kernel.err"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
printf '%s %s\n' "${statuses[0]}" "${statuses[1]}" > "$6/exit-status.txt"
if (( statuses[0] != 0 || statuses[1] != 0 )); then exit 1; fi
grep -Fxq 'challenge proven' "$6/kernel.out"
! grep -Fxq 'Inconsistency proven!' "$6/kernel.out"
